readme: San Bernardino County multi-case LLM contamination fixtures (#2565). Source: dev DB rulings extracted from live San Bernardino tentative ruling PDFs. Two contamination patterns documented: (1) case_title absorbing adjacent case captions when the LLM fuses multi-case PDF headings — e.g. 'Smith v. Jones Doe v. Roe' — should be truncated to the first caption only. (2) ruling_text bleeding from one case into the next when the LLM fails to stop at the horizontal-rule / case-number boundary. (3) role-literal titles where the LLM emits 'Plaintiff v. Defendant' instead of using the actual party names from the ruling body. Expected per-case titles: strip everything from the second 'v.'/'vs.' separator onward when not a valid party name. Expected ruling_text: truncate at the first occurrence of a foreign SB case number (CIVSB*/CIVRS* different from the ruling's own case number).

cross_case_ruling_text.input_text:
Tentative Ruling: DENY Defendant's Motion for Summary Judgment.

This is a personal injury action arising from a slip and fall at a commercial property in San Bernardino. Plaintiff Smith alleges that Defendant failed to maintain the premises in a safe condition.

Legal Standard: A motion for summary judgment shall be granted if all the papers submitted show that there is no triable issue as to any material fact. (Code Civ. Proc., § 437c, subd. (c).)

Analysis: Defendant has not met its initial burden of showing that the premises were in a reasonably safe condition at the time of the incident.

Conclusion: The motion is DENIED.
